scope: Supertonic 3 component-first QNN/HTP feasibility checkpoint; no speedup claim

host_findings.detail: Captured deterministic frozen-transcript Supertonic component fixtures on CPU with seed 20260813; exact observed vocoder latent length is 238.
Created an ignored fixed-I/O-shape derivative [1,144,238] -> [1,731136], SHA-256 989fe86e7bda8f223cb50b0ea2f0ee293371e6ff84ddbe082d8ed8c122088364.

A Q8 per-tensor derivative executed in host HTP emulation but badly diverged from FP32 and released INT8 references (cosine 0.031/0.028; SNR -8.01/-7.62 dB). It is not eligible for phone or audio claims.
With CPU fallback disabled, the fixed released vocoder did not fully assign to QNN CPU; session initialization failed as intended, proving fallback enforcement.
QAIRT 2.49 host HTP attempts loaded the backend/system interfaces but produced no output and zero-byte ORT profiles; they are not proof of HTP execution.
Only non-destructive adb identity/platform properties were captured. No QNN graph or vocoder executed on the phone before this pause.
